ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/TA444 fake-job lure: signed installer/PDF reader drops AppleScript or PowerShell stager to Lazarus C2
ucs.description: Hunts Bluenoroff's hallmark 'RustBucket / KandyKorn / ObjCShellz' style social-engineering chain — a recruiter or VC contact delivers a weaponized PDF viewer or signed installer that spawns a script interpreter (powershell/wscript/osascript) which reaches out to a hard-coded staging URL. This is the defining DPRK financial-cluster delivery pattern (TA444 = Sapphire Sleet = APT38 on the BeagleBoyz cryptocurrency-theft mission) and combines T1566.003, T1204.002, T1059, and T1071.001 — the exact chain Mandiant/CrowdStrike/Microsoft have repeatedly attributed to Stardust Chollima.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("AcroRd32.exe","FoxitPDFReader.exe","SumatraPDF.exe","PDFReaderPro.exe","WPS.exe","WPS Office.exe","Skype.exe","Telegram.exe","WhatsApp.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | rename Processes.* as * | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (80,443,8080,8443) All_Traffic.app="powershell.exe" OR All_Traffic.app="wscript.exe" OR All_Traffic.app="curl.exe" by host All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.app | rename All_Traffic.* as *] | stats values(cmdline) as cmdline values(parent) as parent values(hash) as hash values(dest) as c2_dest min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by host user | where match(cmdline,"(?i)(downloadstring|iex|invoke-expression|webclient|fromBase64String|hidden|-enc|/c\\s+curl|certutil\\s+-urlcache|bitsadmin\\s+/transfer)") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LureParents = dynamic(["AcroRd32.exe","FoxitPDFReader.exe","SumatraPDF.exe","PDFReaderPro.exe","wps.exe","wpsoffice.exe","Skype.exe","Telegram.exe","WhatsApp.exe","slack.exe","Discord.exe"]);
let Stagers = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","rundll32.exe"]);
let ProcChain =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LureParents)
    | where FileName in~ (Stagers)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","WebClient","FromBase64String","-enc","-EncodedCommand","-WindowStyle Hidden","-w hidden","-urlcache","-transfer","http://","https://")
       or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(curl|bitsadmin|certutil).{0,40}https?://";
ProcChain
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (Stagers)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
  ) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where NetTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)     // 5m = empirical stager-to-C2 window from past Bluenoroff cases
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          LureParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          LureParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          Stager = FileName,
          StagerCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256,
          C2_IP = RemoteIP,
          C2_Url = RemoteUrl,
          C2_Port = RemotePort,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, Timestamp)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LureParents = dynamic(["AcroRd32.exe","FoxitPDFReader.exe","SumatraPDF.exe","PDFReaderPro.exe","wps.exe","wpsoffice.exe","Skype.exe","Telegram.exe","WhatsApp.exe","slack.exe","Discord.exe"]);
let Stagers = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","rundll32.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ChildName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ParentName in~ (LureParents)
| where ChildName in~ (Stagers)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine has_any ("DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","WebClient","FromBase64String","-enc","-EncodedCommand","-WindowStyle Hidden","-w hidden","-urlcache","-transfer","http://","https://")
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(curl|bitsadmin|certutil).{0,40}https?://"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, User = SubjectUserName,
          LureParent = ParentName, LureParentCmd = ParentProcessName,
          Stager = ChildName, StagerCmd = CommandLine,
          NewProcessId, LogonId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

logsource:

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff persistence: LaunchAgent / Run-key + AppleScript or VBS pointing to non-Apple/non-MS domain (KandyKorn / ObjCShellz pattern)
ucs.description: Hunts Bluenoroff's post-exploitation persistence: writing a LaunchAgent plist or HKCU\Run value that auto-executes osascript/wscript/powershell against an attacker-controlled host masquerading as legit infrastructure (e.g. swissborg[.]blog, mfdsregistry[.]com). Combines T1547.001, T1543.003, T1059, T1036.005 — the exact post-foothold chain documented across KandyKorn (Elastic), ObjCShellz (Jamf), and the 2024 Sapphire Sleet crypto-wallet thefts.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_data) as run_value values(Registry.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path IN ("*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*","*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*","*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\*") by host Registry.user Registry.registry_key_name Registry.registry_value_name | rename Registry.* as * | where match(run_value,"(?i)(wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh|mshta|rundll32|curl|certutil)") AND match(run_value,"(?i)(https?://|\\.vbs|\\.js|\\.hta|-enc|-encodedcommand|frombase64string|downloadstring|appdata\\\\local\\\\temp|appdata\\\\roaming|programdata)") AND NOT match(run_value,"(?i)(microsoft\\.com|windowsupdate\\.com|office\\.com|adobe\\.com|googleapis\\.com)") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let RunKeys = dynamic([
  @"HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
  @"HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",
  @"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
  @"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",
  @"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon"
]);
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has_any (RunKeys)
| where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh|mshta|rundll32|curl|certutil)"
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(https?://|\.vbs|\.js|\.hta|-enc|-encodedcommand|frombase64string|downloadstring|appdata\\local\\temp|appdata\\roaming|programdata)"
| where not(RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(microsoft\.com|windowsupdate\.com|office\.com|adobe\.com|googleapis\.com|github\.com/microsoft)")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","setup.exe","OfficeClickToRun.exe")
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe")
    | summarize C2Domains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25), C2IPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25) by DeviceId, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
  ) on DeviceId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          WriterProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RegistryKey,
          RegistryValueName,
          AutoRunPayload = RegistryValueData,
          ObservedC2Domains = C2Domains,
          ObservedC2IPs = C2IPs
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let RunKeys = dynamic([
  @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
  @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",
  @"\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon"
]);
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated","RegistryEvent")
| where RegistryKey has_any (RunKeys)
| where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh|mshta|rundll32|curl|certutil)"
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(https?://|\.vbs|\.js|\.hta|-enc|-encodedcommand|frombase64string|downloadstring|appdata\\local\\temp|appdata\\roaming|programdata)"
| where not(RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(microsoft\.com|windowsupdate\.com|office\.com|adobe\.com|googleapis\.com)")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          WriterProcess = ActingProcessName,
          WriterCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValue, AutoRunPayload = RegistryValueData
| order by TimeGenerated desc

status: experimental
description: Detects DPRK Bluenoroff/TA444/APT38 (Sapphire Sleet, Stardust Chollima) writing autostart Run keys whose value invokes wscript/cscript/powershell/curl/certutil against an HTTP URL or staged script in user-writable directory. Mirrors KandyKorn / ObjCShellz / 2024 fake-VC chain.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/15
tags:

  - attack.t1547.001
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0098
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\'
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce\'
      - '\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\'
  selection_payload_interp:
    Details|contains:
      - 'wscript'
      - 'cscript'
      - 'powershell'
      - 'pwsh'
      - 'mshta'
      - 'rundll32'
      - 'curl'
      - 'certutil'
  selection_payload_marker:
    Details|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - '.vbs'
      - '.js'
      - '.hta'

      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
  filter_legit:
    Details|contains:
      - 'microsoft.com'
      - 'windowsupdate.com'
      - 'office.com'
      - 'adobe.com'

level: high

| NOT regex("(?i)(microsoft\\.com|windowsupdate\\.com|office\\.com|adobe\\.com|googleapis\\.com)", field=RegStringValue)

_field_issues.message: `TrustedInstaller` is not a canonical column of DeviceRegistryEvents.
`OfficeClickToRun` is not a canonical column of DeviceRegistryEvents.
`Public` is not a canonical column of DeviceRegistryEvents.
`RemoteUrl` is not a column of DeviceRegistryEvents; it does exist on DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceEvents, AlertEvidence, ASCDeviceEvents.
`RemoteIP` is not a column of DeviceRegistryEvents; it does exist on DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceLogonEvents, DeviceEvents, AlertEvidence, ASCDeviceEvents.
